purpose: Pre-register two independent volume-label and chapter-boundary reviews, gated adjudication, and agreement auditing without creating or implying any human decision.

volume_label_review.review_unit: one physical-book candidate and its printed volume heading
volume_label_review.gold_condition: two exact independent decisions agree or a separate adjudicator resolves every disagreement

chapter_boundary_review.review_unit: one Markdown chapter mapped to exact inclusive scan start and end physical pages
chapter_boundary_review.gold_condition: all chapter items have two exact independent decisions or adjudication plus prespecified agreement audit completion

adjudication.trigger: any decision, transcription, start page, end page, or evidence sufficiency disagreement
